notes: PAPERCLASH (src/PAPERCLASH.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.0.2 implementation. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory. There is no owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, fee, burn, tax, rebase, upgrade path or external call: transfers deliver exactly the amount sent, so the factory's transfer to the distributor, claims from the distributor, the single-sided pool seed through the PoolManager and ordinary swaps all move exactly what they say. Nothing can mint after the constructor, so the supply never grows. This launch deploys no application contracts. The factory takes the swarm's share, seeds 80% of the supply into the ETH pool and forwards the rest to economics.remainderTo; pool.initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
